item.title: Reimagining Acne Care: The Story Behind Spotless with Dr. Amy & Zoe Wechsler
item.description: Spotless, founded by Dr. Amy and Zoe Wechsler, is transforming acne care for teens and young adults by combining medical expertise with a welcoming, accessible clinic model. Their holistic approach addresses both the physical and emotional aspects of acne, offering practical advice, extended hours, and a supportive environment. Spotless aims to break down barriers, empower patients, and redefine what it means to care for your skin.

item.title: AI and the Future of Work with Karin Klein of Bloomberg Beta
item.description: As the world of work transforms at an unprecedented pace, driven by innovations in artificial intelligence and evolving career paths, young women entering the business world find themselves at a crossroads. How do they anticipate and leverage the next big trends? In a recent episode of the BizEmpress podcast, I sat down with Karin Klein, Founding Partner at Bloomberg Beta, who has dedicated her career to navigating these very questions, to discuss investing, leadership, and the future of work.
